marketLayer.title: US Tech & AI Hardware Expansion
marketLayer.fact: Leading US cloud hyper-scalers reported upgraded capital expenditure projections for AI data center infrastructure through H2 2026, driving pre-market gains in semiconductor equipment manufacturers.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained CapEx commitments reinforce earnings visibility for high-bandwidth memory and custom ASIC suppliers across US and connected global tech ecosystems.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Monetization pace of end-user AI enterprise software and potential tightening of cross-border technology trade restrictions.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Internet & E-Commerce Sector Momentum
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index closed up 1.8% today, led by major Chinese e-commerce and cloud gaming giants following heavy share buyback executions and Southbound Stock Connect capital inflows.
marketLayer.inference: Aggressive share repurchase programs combined with cost-efficiency discipline are enhancing per-share earnings quality, attracting institutional value investors.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Quarterly revenue growth dependence on mainland consumer spending recovery and competitive price discounting pressures.

marketLayer.title: US Macro Policy & Yield Environment
marketLayer.fact: Latest US inflation indicators aligned with market consensus, maintaining 10-year Treasury yields near 4.10% while fed funds futures continue to price in an easing cycle before year-end.
marketLayer.inference: A stable interest rate outlook mitigates valuation compression risk for growth equities and improves secondary market liquidity in Hong Kong capital markets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential commodity price volatility and macroeconomic shifts influencing central bank monetary policy timelines.

marketLayer.title: HK-Listed New Energy Vehicle Sector
marketLayer.fact: Top-tier Chinese EV makers listed in Hong Kong reported strong mid-summer delivery estimates alongside accelerated export channel expansion into European and Middle Eastern markets.
marketLayer.inference: Overseas market penetration helps offset domestic price competition and stabilizes gross margin profiles for market-share leaders.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Implementation details of foreign trade tariffs and local compliance/certification timelines in overseas jurisdictions.
